rules: Every in-scope asset class has exactly one disposition.
BOUNDED_ADAPTER means only the named adapter and scope are implemented; it does not imply whole-product migration.
Assets with no safe transfer implementation remain fail-closed and cannot be silently dropped.
Revoked, expired, destroyed, or single-use state must never be resurrected by migration or rollback.
Repository tests and local rehearsals cannot self-grant migration, cutover, rollback, production, or release authority.

assets.required_exit: Convert and verify supported server/system configuration without importing OpenBao barrier or snapshot bytes.

Expand the bounded single-namespace user-policy transfer to every namespace, reconcile built-in default/root semantics explicitly, and prove token/revocation cutover plus rollback cannot preserve stale authority.
Preserve namespace hierarchy and ownership without cross-namespace policy or mount rebinding.

assets.source_owner: auth mount registry and method configuration
assets.required_exit: Expand bounded auth-mount recreation across every supported namespace/mount; preserve tune semantics while allocating new target accessors/incarnations, force consumer re-authentication, and prove source credentials/tokens cannot regain authority after cutover or rollback.

Expand bounded entity/internal-group recreation across namespaces and explicitly resolve aliases, external groups, group aliases, merged lineage and authentication accessor bindings through re-authentication or reviewed reconstruction; prove no old identity authority is resurrected.
Use an explicit re-authentication/cutover strategy; revoked, expired, exhausted, or accessor-only token state must not become usable authority.
Expand from explicitly selected contiguous readable histories to an inventory-complete policy for destroyed/deleted/pruned versions and every KV mount before cutover.

assets.source_owner: Transit engine and application ciphertext references
assets.required_exit: Inventory every Transit key/version and update all application ciphertext references under a fenced, resumable cutover; key export is not assumed.
Define private-key custody, issuer/role/certificate/CRL transfer or deliberate reissuance, preserving revocation state.

Expand the bounded single-namespace SSH OTP role-configuration transfer to every SSH mount; explicitly migrate or reissue CA/issuer state, drain source-issued OTP/lease authority, preserve mount incarnation, and prove host/PAM cutover plus rollback cannot resurrect credentials.
Transfer connection/role configuration without exposing credentials and reconcile all external leases/revocations against real providers.
Every enabled in-scope engine requires an explicit migrate, recreate, or unsupported disposition; omission is a blocker.
Reconcile renewable/revoked/expired leases and provider effects without duplicate issuance or resurrection.
Recreate supported audit configuration with new HeptaBao keys/chains; do not import OpenBao audit secrets as equivalent local chain state.
Use logical asset migration into a freshly initialized HeptaBao cluster; raw OpenBao snapshots/barrier/Raft bytes are not format-compatible.

assets.source_owner: response wrapping and token-private cubbyhole state
assets.required_exit: Cutover must invalidate outstanding wrapping/ephemeral authority rather than recreating it as fresh usable state.
Re-enroll provider trust and credentials from approved custody, then execute provider-specific readback/revocation tests.
Inventory endpoints, auth paths, policy dependencies, Transit ciphertext references, leases, agents/proxies and trust roots; rehearse atomic switch and rollback.
